settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: In-stock beds arrive in 3–5 working days to UK mainland addresses. Made-to-order upholstery takes 3–4 weeks, and the lead time is shown on every product page before you buy.

settings.question: What is included in delivery?
settings.answer: Two-person delivery to the room of your choice, full assembly, and removal of all packaging. There is no extra charge for any of it on UK mainland orders.

settings.question: Do you deliver to Scotland, Northern Ireland and the islands?
settings.answer: Yes. Highlands, islands and Northern Ireland are quoted separately at checkout because they go via a specialist carrier — the price is shown before you pay.

settings.question: Can I get fabric swatches?
settings.answer: Order up to five free swatches and we post them first class the same day. It is the single best way to avoid a return.

settings.question: What is the 100-night trial?
settings.answer: Sleep on your bed for up to 100 nights. If it is not right, contact us and we collect it and refund you in full — no restocking fee, and you do not need to have kept the packaging.

settings.question: How do I know what size I need?
settings.answer: UK sizes: single 90×190cm, double 135×190cm, king 150×200cm, super king 180×200cm. Leave 60cm of walking space each side where you can, and 90cm in front of wardrobe doors.

settings.question: Will it fit up my stairs?
settings.answer: Frames and headboards ship separately and assemble in the room, so tight landings are rarely a problem. Boxed dimensions are listed on every product page. Send us a photo of the stairwell if you are unsure.

settings.question: Can I pay in instalments?
settings.answer: Klarna and Clearpay are available at checkout — three interest-free payments, with a soft credit check that will not affect your score.

settings.question: What does the guarantee cover?
settings.answer: Ten years on the frame and gas-lift mechanism, two years on fabric and stitching. Normal domestic use, repaired or replaced free of charge.

settings.question: Do you take away my old bed?
settings.answer: Yes — add old-bed removal at checkout and our delivery team takes your existing frame and mattress away for recycling on the same visit.

settings.heading: Everything we get asked
settings.footer_text: Cannot find it? Our bed specialists reply in under an hour, 9–6 daily.
